name: Anthelmir

abilities.name: Devastating Flare
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Blazing Strike
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing moderate-high flame damage

abilities.name: Scorching Hammer
abilities.description: Charged melee attack dealing very high flame damage.

abilities.name: Heat Blast
abilities.description: Anthelmir slams her staff on the ground, causing a massive explosion around her, indicated by a very large red circle. The initial blast deals very high flame damage and flames linger on for a while after, dealing continuous low flame damage. While Anthelmir is in the lingering flames, she gains a ward that makes her invulnerable in the form of a damage shield (Blast Furnace).

abilities.name: Blasted Shards
abilities.description: While in her ward, she performs this ability. She points her staff forward, blasting targets with repeated fireballs, dealing moderate flame damage each.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.description: Anthelmir teleports from her current position, causing a detonation at both her starting and next positions, indicated by red circles, dealing moderate flame damage. She will often teleport near barrels to detonate them.

abilities.name: Kindlepitch Barrel
abilities.description: Kindlepitch barrels are scattered around the arena, which explode if fire from enemies makes contact with them. The resulting explosion deals immediate high flame damage, indicated by a red circle around them, and causes flames to linger for the rest of the fight, dealing continuous low flame damage.

abilities.name: Construct Transformation
abilities.description: When the construct reaches 70% health, both it and Anthelmir rush to the center of the arena and the construct plants one of its hands into the ground, causing the arena to shake. Shortly after, the head of a Malacath statue falls on top of the construct, causing the construct to fall over, landing on Anthelmir and killing her instantly. Afterward, the construct gets up, fortifies the statue head with vines, and gains new abilities.

summary: Anthelmir is a Wood Elf member of the Recollection that serves as the second boss of Oathsworn Pit, along with her Construct. Maerolor is her boyfriend.
